units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 13:5">Targ. Ps. XIII, 5</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Chagigah 16a:13">Ḥag. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>דמצי כייף ליה ליצריה</he> when he can conquer his passion.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 64a:6">Snh. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>היינו י׳ דע״ז</he> this (lion of fire) is the passion for (tempter to) idolatry.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 64a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ניבעי רחמי אַיִּ׳ דעבירה</he> let us pray against the sensual desire (the tempter to sexual indulgence); a. fr.
